method: Eleven complete pinned XML source files read,537 lines. All11 parsed as XML. Five direct provider R.id references compared with corresponding layout declared IDs. Structural source check, not Android resource compilation/rendering.

executed_controls.method: ElementTree parses layout; regex R.id.name gathers direct references in each pinned provider source; set difference must be empty. Does not resolve inherited methods, drawable/style resources, RemoteViews action support or framework IDs.

findings: All five direct provider/layout ID sets resolve, no missing target ID in these pairs. This narrows failures to behavior/build/RemoteViews qualification rather than inventing nonexistent IDs. Compact layout deliberately contains hidden favorite/progress views.

Explorer actual layout five equally weighted categories Internal/Down/Images/Docs/Music, while Compose widget preview showed onlythreeicons. Large music actual layout horizontalart+title/artist then fourcontrols; Compose preview simplified layout. Source preview not pixel/runtime parity.

Music controls ImageViews without contentDescription in XML, search toggle also no contentDescription; provider code does not set descriptions. Text may label some navigation, but accessibility outcome needs TalkBack/device qualification; no certification.
Searchcapsule fixed56dp inside8dp rootpadding; 24dp toggle icon with1dppadding. Musiccompact controls32/36dp; minimum host size/fontscale/resizing need rendered review, not assumed usable from XML.

Night widget colors follow resource qualifier while provider helper chooses app preference DARK/LIGHT/SYSTEM and overrides text/bg. Not all icons overridden (explorer intentionally leavesicons); actual light/dark compositecontrast pending drawable/visual review.

Theme XML systembars transparent/lightflagsfalse; API29contrastdisable overridespresent. Later Compose theme adjusts iconappearance. Startup/window transition appearance cannot be judged from either source alone.
Only app_name string resource; widget labels hardcodedEnglish in XML and prior Kotlin. Localization absent for these labels, not proof of all locale behavior.
